verdict.rationale: Windmill's AI generation docs describe a built-in AI that edits workspace items and, when asked, reviews those changes and opens the Compare & Deploy page with the edited items preselected. That is real in-product delegation, but the evidence is one thin snippet, so the range of tasks the assistant can take on is not shown. AI Agent flow steps are a building block for constructing flows, and MCP access is for external clients, so neither counts here. missing for 10: documentation of the assistant's interface and the range of tasks it handles, evidence of multi-step autonomous task execution beyond editing items, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Once the AI has edited items, ask it to review the changes and it opens the Compare & Deploy page with exactly those items preselected, ready to deploy.
